column1: # Product-name occurrences inside the six copied trees (`lisp`, `test`, `etc`, `doc`,
# `leim`, `admin` -> `femacs/<top>/**`), one per line.  PORTING.md 0.1-19 says those trees are
# copied, and `tools/check-verbatim.py` holds them byte for byte; the tenth half of the rule
# (status 3.613, 2026-10-05) is the one exception: a *string the reference program prints* that
# names the reference product as this program's own name, welcome, warranty line or generated-file
# identity is this program's outward identity, so it carries this repository's name instead.
# The rule is mechanical - the token is replaced and nothing else on the line changes - and every
# row is read by the gate: the target's line must be exactly the text below, the reference's line
# must differ from it, and a row for a file the copy does not carry, or a difference with no row,
# is a failure.  Columns: <repo-relative target path>\t<line>\t<the target's line>\t<reason>.
